compiled_state.title: Update epic template, story body template, and verifiable-sc-check.md with ## Closure Checks section
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: `## Closure Checks` section template added to epic and story ticket body templates; section placement is **after** `## Success Criteria`
- DD2: `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/verifiable-sc-check.md` updated with option (c) "Route to Closure Checks"

## Implementation

### File 1: `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/epic-description-template.md`

In the `## Template` code block, add `## Closure Checks` section after `## Success Criteria` and before `## Dependencies`:

```
## Success Criteria
- [criterion 1]
- [criterion 2]

## Closure Checks
- [durable end-state acceptance criterion that would fail the session-infeasibility check but is not transitional work]
(Leave empty if all SCs pass the verifiable-sc-check litmus; populate only for criteria routed here via option (c))
```

### File 2: `plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md`

In Phase H Step 2, where the story body template sections are shown (the code block showing `## Done Definitions`, `## Success Criteria`), add `## Closure Checks` section after `## Success Criteria`:

```
## Closure Checks
- (items routed from verifiable-sc-check.md option (c) — durable end-state intent that is not session-verifiable)
```

This section should appear in the story body template example in Phase H.

### File 3: `plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/verifiable-sc-check.md`

In the `## Remediation for session-infeasible SCs — pick one` section, add option (c) after (b):

```
**(c) Route to Closure Checks** — add the criterion to the epic's or story's `## Closure Checks` section when it represents durable end-state intent (something that should remain true after the epic is closed) but cannot be evaluated deterministically during the closing session.

Criteria suitable for Closure Checks: architectural invariants, operational health targets, non-regressing behavioral contracts. Do NOT use Closure Checks for one-time transitional work (setup steps, migration markers, manual verification checkboxes) — those belong in the Done Definitions as explicit closure tasks.
```

### Section Ordering (critical)

`## Closure Checks` MUST appear AFTER `## Success Criteria` in all templates. Parser scripts scan ticket bodies sequentially — placing `## Closure Checks` before `## Success Criteria` breaks extraction.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] `epic-description-template.md` contains `## Closure Checks` section after `## Success Criteria`
  Verify: awk '/## Success Criteria/{sc=NR} /## Closure Checks/{cc=NR} END{exit (sc>0 && cc>sc) ? 0 : 1}' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/epic-description-template.md
- [ ] `verifiable-sc-check.md` contains option (c) text
  Verify: grep -q 'Route to Closure Checks' plugins/dso/skills/shared/prompts/verifiable-sc-check.md
- [ ] preplanning SKILL.md Phase H story body template contains `## Closure Checks` section
  Verify: grep -q '## Closure Checks' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
